The good news? 1-800-GOT-JUNK? offers a fast, reliable, and environmentally responsible way to clear out the clutter. In this guide we’ll walk through everything you need to know—pricing, scheduling, eco‑friendly practices, and how to get the most out of your service.

Why Choose 1-800-GOT-JUNK? in St Louis

When it comes to junk removal, you have a few options: DIY hauling, hiring a local contractor, or calling a national brand. Here’s why 1-800-GOT-JUNK? stands out for Missourians:

  • Same‑day service in most neighborhoods—perfect for those last‑minute clean‑outs.
  • Transparent pricing with no hidden fees; you pay by the load, not by the hour.
  • Eco‑friendly disposal that recycles or donates up to 60% of collected items.
  • Fully insured crews, so you never worry about accidents or damage.
  • Local expertise—the St Louis team knows the city’s recycling rules and landfill regulations.

How the Process Works

Step 1: Get Your Quote

Start by calling or using the online form to describe the junk you need removed. A friendly dispatcher will ask about the type, size, and location of the load, then give you a ballpark estimate. The quote is always all‑inclusive, covering labor, transportation, and disposal.

Step 2: Schedule a Pickup

Once you’re happy with the estimate, pick a convenient date. In St Louis, many customers enjoy same‑day or next‑day service, especially during the week. The team arrives in a branded truck, ready to lift heavy items without you needing to touch a thing.

Step 3: Load and Go

Just point out what you want gone. The crew handles everything—from old sofas and mattresses to construction debris and yard waste. They’ll load the truck, clean the area if needed, and leave your space tidy.

Step 4: Disposal & Recycling

After the load leaves your property, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? sorts the items at a local facility. Recyclable materials (metal, wood, plastics) go back into the supply chain, while items that can be donated are sent to charities across the St Louis area.

Pricing & What’s Included

Unlike hourly junk removal services, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? charges by the load. A “load” generally fits in the back of a 12‑foot truck (about 8–10 cubic yards). Prices in St Louis typically range from $150 to $300 per load, depending on volume and material type. Here’s what’s covered:

  • Labor—no lifting or carrying on your part.
  • Transportation—fuel, driver, and truck.
  • Disposal fees—landfill, recycling, or donation costs.
  • Insurance—peace of mind for any accidental damage.

Special items like hot tubs, large appliances, or hazardous waste may incur a modest surcharge, but the dispatcher will tell you upfront.

Eco‑Friendly Practices in St Louis

St Louis residents are proud of their city’s green initiatives, and 1-800-GOT-JUNK? aligns perfectly. The company’s sustainability goals include:

  • Recycling at least 60% of each load.
  • Donations to local nonprofits such as the St Louis Habitat for Humanity ReStore.
  • Composting yard waste whenever possible.
  • Carbon‑offsetting a portion of each truck’s emissions.

If you’re a homeowner’s association or a business in the Central West End, you can even request a detailed recycling report after the job.

Tips to Prepare for Your Pickup

While the crew does all the heavy lifting, a little prep can speed up the process and keep costs down:

  • Separate recyclables (like cardboard and glass) from the junk you want removed.
  • Break down large items (e.g., disassemble a bed frame) to maximize truck space.
  • Clear a path from the item to the driveway or street for easy access.
  • Identify hazardous materials (paint cans, batteries) so the team can handle them safely.
  • Make a quick inventory—know the approximate number of pieces and their approximate size.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to be home when the truck arrives?

No. A trusted neighbor or a property manager can grant the crew access. Just make sure the pickup area is clear.

Can I schedule a recurring service for ongoing waste?

Absolutely. Many St Louis landlords set up monthly or quarterly pickups to keep rental units clean.

What happens to items that can’t be recycled?

Those items are taken to a certified landfill in the region. The company follows state regulations to minimize environmental impact.
